decisions.evidence: Taken together, all six neighbors are more compatible with option (A) than with option (B). The three substrate neighbors are all outweighed by repeated non-substrate-like shifts in alkyl chloride count, charge descriptors, basic-site patterning, acceptor count, surface area, and shape features, while the three non-substrate neighbors reinforce the same direction through largely the same kinds of evidence. The combined neighbor evidence therefore supports the provided label: the query is not a substrate to CYP2C9.
